cc:Work.dc:title: Tray - TypeTray
cc:Work.dc:description:
Type tray - allows only continuous walls
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes TypeTray --sx '60*2' --sy '40*3' --h 70 --hi 40 --outside 0 --bottom_edge h --top_edge f --fingerholes front-and-back --gripwidth 0 --gripheight 30 --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes TypeTray --sx --sy --h --hi --outside --top_edge --fingerholes --reference --labels
